rows.question: Under the BNSS, what is the procedure regarding trial of offences under bharatiya nyaya sanhita, 2023 and other laws?
rows.answer:
Answer
All offences under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 are triable according to this Sanhita, subject to specific enactments regulating their investigation/trial. Other laws' offences follow the same provisions but must be listed in the First Schedule. [S1], [S2].

**Statutory text [S1] Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 - Section 4: Trial of offences under Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and other laws**
> (1) All offences under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 shall be investigated, inquired into, tried, and otherwise dealt with according to the provisions hereinafter contained. (2) All offences under any other law shall be investigated, inquired into, tried, and otherwise dealt with according to the same provisions, but subject to any enactment for the time being in force regulating the manner or place of investigating, inquiring into, trying or otherwise dealing with such offences.

rows.question: Cite the exact provision of the BNSS that deals with trial to be conducted by public prosecutor.
rows.answer:
Answer
The trial before a Court of Session must be conducted by "a Public Prosecutor." [S1]

Relevant law
Section 248 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 mandates this specific arrangement. [S1]

Application/explanation
This section dictates the primary mode of prosecution for serious offences handled directly by the Sessions Courts themselves rather than relying on private lawyers or police officers conducting trials independently. [S1,S2]

Sources
[Source: Section 248, BNSS 2023] [Source: Section 339, BNSS 2023] [Source: Section 338, BNSS 2023] [Source: Section 18, BNSS 2023] [Source: Section 19, BNSS 2023]

**Statutory text [S1] Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 - Section 248: Trial to be conducted by Public Prosecutor**
> In every trial before a Court of Session, the prosecution shall be conducted by a Public Prosecutor.
